canonical_title: Pre-Training and In-Training Support for Clients
aliases: Support to individual learners to address needs and interests

one_line_answer.text: A TVET teacher gives pre-training and in-training supports to his clients.

cites.quote: The pre-training and in-training supports by a TVET teacher to his clients are:

bangla_explanation: কিছু client-এর বাড়তি সহায়তা লাগে, যেমন ভাষা, প্রতিবন্ধিতা বা সংস্কৃতির কারণে।
Training শুরুর আগে: learning objectives-কে work trends-এর সাথে মেলানো, financial assistance-এর পরামর্শ দেওয়া।
Training চলাকালীন: appropriate delivery methods, clients-কে একে অপরের থেকে শিখতে দেওয়া, diversity activities।
প্রশ্নে যেকোনো পাঁচটা চাইলে দুই ভাগ থেকেই লিখুন।

example.en: Before training, a centre gives a deaf learner materials in large print. During training, it organizes an interpreter.
example.bn: শুরুর আগে large print materials, চলাকালীন interpreters রাখা।

traps.text: Pre-training support: provide advice on financial assistance.
In-training support: organize for interpreters to be present.

cites.quote: Organize for interpreters to be Provide flexibility in training scheduling present

short.prompt: Discuss any five pre-training and in-training supports by a TVET teacher to his clients.
short.modelAnswer:
A TVET teacher gives pre-training and in-training supports.
Pre-training support:
1. Ensure learning objectives relate to work trends
2. Align training to organizational protocols
3. Provide advice on financial assistance
In-training support:
4. Incorporate appropriate delivery methods
5. Allow clients to learn from each other
6. Build in diversity activities

keyPoints.text: Pre-training: ensure learning objectives relate to work trends.
Pre-training: align training to organizational protocols.
Pre-training: allow client representation on committees.
Pre-training: build underpinning knowledge into materials.
In-training: ensure physical and communication support.
In-training: allow clients to learn from each other.

cites.quote: Allow clients to learn from each

keyPoints.text: In-training: allow clients to provide direction, and build in diversity activities.
